Bihar MLC Political Controversy : bihar MLC chunav ke natijon ke bad rahul raj ki bijepi men vapsi ko lekar siyasi vivad shuru ho gaya hai. rahul raj ko chhah sal ke lie parti se nishkasit kiya gaya tha, lekin chunav jitne ke turant bad unki bijepi men vapsi ho gaee. aise men saval uth raha hai ki aakhir nishkasan ke bavjud itni jaldi unki vapsi kin paristhitiyon men huee? bijepi ke is phaisle par kyon uth rahe hain saval? dekhie puri riporta.
